findings.summary: Luna missed the current 36-page Whiskey Bible PDF linked by the official menu navigation and incorrectly treated the menu catalog as complete.
Luna omitted visible current food-page products and nearly the entire visible drink-page catalog while claiming scope completeness.

The menu's global statement that peanut oil is used in fryers does not identify every listed item as using a fryer, sharing fryer equipment, or carrying peanut cross-contact. Luna's blanket mayContain peanut arrays are unsupported.

No restaurant-issued complete allergen matrix or full ingredient disclosure was found. Narrow named-ingredient positives are supportable, but negatives, complete arrays, and item-specific cross-contact conclusions are not.

verifier.summary: Independent verification found material scope and cross-contact discrepancies. Barrel identity and the two HTML menu surfaces are verified, but Luna omitted the linked current Whiskey Bible PDF and many visible current products, especially the drink-menu catalog. The restaurant-issued pages provide no complete allergen matrix; direct named-ingredient positives are narrow only, and the global peanut-oil fryer statement cannot support blanket item-level may-contain peanut arrays.
